objective: Implement Step 08 Cancel Disputes (F8): Scoped auditable cancellation and dispute cases with bilateral decisions, privacy-aware evidence, conflict serialization, actual-head migration, UI case history, and empirical test gates.

requirements.text: Persist scoped cancellation and dispute case requests with type, reason, agreement version/hash, obligation references, actor, timestamp, evidence visibility, and atomic audit/outbox events.
requirements.acceptance: Domain model, database tables, and repository persist cases with audit and outbox integration.

requirements.text: Preserve existing pre-commit cancellation behavior without regression.
requirements.acceptance: Pre-commit deals in DRAFT/NEGOTIATING cancel directly via existing cancel route/use-case; tests pass.

requirements.text: Distinguish case creation from effective cancellation, liability, refund, or settlement; surface operational impact blockers for paid or in-flight consequences.
requirements.acceptance: Case creation does not modify payment status or delivery obligations; blockers remain visible.

requirements.text: Enforce authorized bilateral decisions for mutual cancellation on matching agreement version/hash with zero AI authority.
requirements.acceptance: POST /cases/{id}/respond enforces bilateral counterparty authorization and version hash consistency.

requirements.text: Serialize concurrent conflicts with payments, amendments, and fulfillment using optimistic checks and no network calls inside DB locks.
requirements.acceptance: Concurrent cases and stale versions return HTTP 409 Conflict; no network inside DB transactions.

requirements.text: Support private and scoped evidence states with strict tenant boundary checks.
requirements.acceptance: Counterparty-restricted or private evidence is filtered out for unauthorized tenants.

requirements.text: Actual-head additive database migration 0025 with downgrade preservation and history-loss block.
requirements.acceptance: Alembic migration 0025_cancel_disputes applies cleanly on top of 0024; downgrade blocks history loss.

requirements.text: Frontend UI case history and bilateral decision controls in DealDetailPage.
requirements.acceptance: DealDetailPage renders case history, dispute/cancellation requests, evidence visibility, and bilateral actions; frontend tests pass.

requirements.text: Independent review verification, focused test gates, full static/test gates green, and progress report updated.
requirements.acceptance: Reviewer verifies diff, focused test discovery script passes, DealDetailPage.test.tsx passes, lint/build green, progress.md and 08-cancel-disputes.md updated.
